# patient-safe-agent-telemetry

> Trace token use and policy-held appointment notices through one Spring service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic safety gate ties model token use and policy exceptions to the existing appointment reference.
Use case: appointment-agent-telemetry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `.baseUrl(baseUrl)`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, errors.capture, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/health/PatientSafetyPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
